punchline: A few stones do not explain a week of violence; crowded housing behind the beach does.
thirty_sec: On 27 July 1919 in Chicago, 17-year-old Eugene Williams drifted into the white section of the 29th Street beach, was struck by stones and drowned. The week of violence that followed killed 38 people; the commission's report named housing and jobs among the causes.
question: Behind your last argument, what scarce resource had been building for a long time?
key_contrast: The spark was small; the load had built for years.
